compiled_state.title: [reconciler/inbound_differ]: out-of-window Jira-side edits never mirrored to local (snapshot-bound inbound)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Symmetric gap to 1e08. inbound_differ iterates only jira_snapshot.items() (inbound_differ.py:562), so a Jira issue outside the fetch working set (status=Done beyond _DONE_RECENT_CAP=1000, fetcher.py:40-61) is invisible to inbound. If such an issue is edited Jira-side, the change is never pulled to the local ticket -> a second silent-drop in the bidirectional-replication goal. Out of scope for 1e08 (which fixes the OUTBOUND direction), but must be tracked. Natural fix: symmetric inbound bounded-GET over bound-but-absent keys reusing the 1e08 budget/retirement machinery.
